[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-158[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Live, streaming progress for sase update[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`sase update` shows every step as it happens: a live timeline on [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]terminals and an append-only log when output is piped. It streams [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the tail of slow subprocess output (cargo, uv), shows each [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]checkout's commits and diffstat as it fast-forwards, expands the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]failing step's output on error, survives Ctrl-C cleanly, and always[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]leaves a full log file behind. The JSON and quiet contracts stay [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]stable.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202609/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]sase_update_live_progress.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202609/sase_update_live_progress.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-158[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-158/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Streaming subprocess runner[/bold #D7AFFF]                                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]stream-runner[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]stream-runner: add a line-streaming subprocess primitive with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sanitization, timeout, and process-group interrupt handling, and plumb [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]an optional on_output sink through run_dev_update_command, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]run_recorded_command, and run_uv without changing their existing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]behavior.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Progress event protocol, timeline model, and renderers[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]progress-model[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]progress-model: create the sase.update_progress package: the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]UpdateProgress event protocol plus a null sink, a thread-safe timeline [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]model, the rich Live renderer, the plain append-only renderer, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]full-run log file sink, and a fan-out sink.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Emit progress events from dev-update, uv, and mode-switch [/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]backends[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]instrument-backends[dim] · [dim][/dim]after stream-runner, progress-model[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]instrument-backends: thread an optional progress sink through [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plan_dev_update, execute_dev_update (fetch, preflight, merge, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reconcile), and execute_mode_switch. Emit step events with friendly [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]titles and result details, and route subprocess output into the running [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]step.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Wire the live timeline into the sase update live path[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]wire-live-update[dim] · [dim][/dim]after instrument-backends[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]wire-live-update: add the -v/--verbose flag and renderer selection, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]declare the step timeline, run the managed uv upgrade as a streamed step[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with live package rows, add restart and completion rows, print the final[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]frame and a deduplicated summary, expand output on failure, handle [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Ctrl-C with exit 130, and add log_path to the JSON output.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Mode switch, dry-run, and documentation[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]wire-mode-switch-dry-run-docs[dim] · [dim][/dim]after wire-live-update[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]wire-mode-switch-dry-run-docs: move --to mode switches onto the same [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]live session after confirmation, show a transient timeline while [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]--dry-run plans its fetches, and update the plugins.md and cli.md docs [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with the new output and the --verbose flag.[/#D7D7AF]
